# SaltWatch Card 0.5.6

This release completes the restored LOW-marker layout after visual review in the simulator.

## What changed

- The tank and ruler use the balanced, centered proportions of the approved reference layout.
- The LOW pill sits close to the percentage labels without overlapping them.
- The orange threshold line remains continuous and stops at the inside edge of the tank window instead of entering the black frame.
- The development simulator now includes a Low marker slider for testing any threshold percentage.
- Responsive regression coverage checks the standard reference width, narrow cards, percentage-label clearance, and the line endpoint.

## Compatibility

- Existing card configurations continue to work without changes.
- No dashboard YAML changes are required.
- The emulator and SaltWatch firmware are unaffected.

## Validation

- 49 unit tests passed.
- 43 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
- The release workflow rebuilds and publishes the checked JavaScript asset.
